business_onboarding.list.description: Paginated list of business sub-accounts under a Partner Main-Account, ordered by creation time (most recent first).

items.description: Current state of a business sub-account, including the data captured during onboarding, its controllers and intermediaries, the documents associated with the business, and the onboarding lifecycle status.

oneOf.description: Public account id assigned to the business sub-account. Stable for the lifetime of the sub-account. `null` until the sub-account has been fully provisioned.

external_id.description: Partner-supplied identifier for the business in the partner's own system.

legal_name.description: Legal name of the business as registered with the relevant tax or company authority.

description.description: Free-form description of the nature of the business and its activities.

oneOf.description: Legal form of the business being onboarded.

status.description: Current status of the document.

required.description: Whether the document type is required for the sub-account to complete onboarding.

filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded document. `null` when the document is still pending upload.

documents.description: Documents required and uploaded for this controller, typically `ID_FRONT`, `ID_BACK`, and `POA`.

controllers.description: Beneficial owners and control persons of the business, including the documents uploaded for each controller.

Highest approved KYC level. Numeric alias of `tier` for ordering /
comparisons. `tier` is the typed enum primary representation;
`kyc_level = tier as u8` (TIER0=0, TIER1=1, TIER2=2, TIER3=3). Both

kyc_status.description:

- `DRAFT`: Application created, awaiting document uploads
- `PROCESSING`: Submitted and under automated review
- `ACTION_REQUIRED`: Client action needed — reupload documents (check `action_required.items`)
- `UNDER_REVIEW`: Under manual compliance review; no client action required
- `APPROVED`: KYC2 approved; tier locked at first approval
- `REJECTED`: Application permanently rejected

external_accounts.get_by_idempotency_key.description: Response object containing complete external bank account information

external_account_id.description:
Unique identifier for the external account (UUID format).
Use this ID for all subsequent operations (retrieve, delete, withdrawals).

idempotency_key.description:
Idempotency key associated with the account creation request.
Used to prevent duplicate account creation and for retrieving accounts by idempotency key.
Empty string if the account was created without an idempotency key.

status.description:
Current status of the bank account.
- PENDING: Account is awaiting verification or approval
- APPROVED: Account is verified and can be used for withdrawals
- FAILED: Account verification failed or was rejected

network.description:
Bank network type for the external account. External account creation
supports standard bank networks only.
- US_FEDWIRE: For US domestic wire transfers (same-day settlement)
- US_ACH: For US domestic ACH transfers (next-day settlement, lower fees)
- US_RTP: For US real-time payments (instant settlement)
- SWIFT: For international wire transfers via the SWIFT network

nickname.description:
User-defined nickname or label for the account (optional).
Helps identify the account in listings.

account_holder_name.description:
Full legal name of the account holder (individual or entity).
This is the name registered with the bank for compliance and verification.

currency.description: Currency of the bank account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

country_code.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code in uppercase (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).
Represents the country where the bank account is held.

institution_name.description: Full legal name of the bank institution.

institution_clearing_code.description:
Additional local or regional routing codes required by specific payment networks or countries.
Examples: Sort codes (UK), BSB numbers (Australia), transit numbers (Canada).

oneOf.description:
Intermediary bank information (optional).
Required for some international wire transfers when the destination bank
does not have a direct correspondent relationship with the originating bank.

institution_id.description:
The intermediary institution identifier (SWIFT code or ABA routing number).
For USD international wires: ABA number of the US correspondent bank that serves as intermediary.
For non-USD wires: SWIFT code of the intermediary bank (if required by the payment network).
Required when the destination bank does not have a direct relationship with the sending institution.

reference_code.description:
Reference code for wire transfers (optional).
A unique identifier that should be included in wire transfer memos
to help identify and reconcile incoming payments.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the account was created (ISO 8601 format with timezone).
Reflects the initial registration time in the system.

modified_at.description:
Timestamp of the last modification to the account (ISO 8601 format with timezone).
Updated when account details are changed or status is updated.

oneOf.description:
Recipient information associated with this bank account.
Present only when the bank account belongs to a recipient (third-party).
Absent for the customer's own (first-party) bank accounts.

recipient_id.description:
Counterparty ID. Empty values are still allowed for legacy DB columns where
an empty cpid means the record is not tied to a recipient.

full_name.description: Full name computed from name fields

status.description:
Recipient status.
Possible values: active, in_review, failed

code.description:

memorandum.description:

mode.description:

main account on behalf of the customer specified in `on_behalf_of`.

on_behalf_of.description:
The customer ID to execute the withdrawal on behalf of.
Required when `mode` is `prefunding`. The customer must belong
to the same entity as the API key owner.

amount_type.description:
Controls how the fee is applied to the withdrawal amount.

- `SEND_AMOUNT` (default): Fee is deducted from the amount. Amount = what leaves the sender.
- `RECEIVE_AMOUNT`: Fee is added on top. Amount = what the recipient gets.
